title: Gun used in Oregon elementary school shooting was birthday gift from shooter's mom, sources say - CBS News
description: The Maverick 88 pump-action 12-gauge shotgun was purchased legally in August 2026 by Shauntai Nickerson, the mother of the shooter, and given to him for recreational use, sources told CBS News.
